objects.description: No custom data types are defined in this header. It only declares two free functions in the djitools namespace: version() and simple_checksum().

functions.name: djitools::version
functions.description: Returns a static, null-terminated version string for the djitools shim. Typical usage is to query the library’s version for logging or compatibility checks. The returned pointer refers to read-only storage with static lifetime.
requirements: The returned pointer must be treated as read-only; do not modify or free it.
The returned C-string is expected to be null-terminated and remain valid for the duration of the process (static storage).
May be called at any time; no initialization order is implied by the declaration.

functions.name: djitools::simple_checksum
functions.signature: int djitools::simple_checksum(const unsigned char* data, int len);
functions.description: Computes a 16-bit additive checksum over the provided buffer. Intended for simple integrity checks where a fast, non-cryptographic checksum is sufficient. Returns the checksum as an int, with the meaningful value in the lower 16 bits.
requirements: If len > 0, data must be a valid, non-null pointer to a buffer of at least len bytes readable by the caller.
If len == 0, data may be null and the function should return the additive identity (commonly 0) for an empty buffer.
The function is non-cryptographic and should not be used for security-sensitive validation.
Caller should only use the lower 16 bits of the return value, as the checksum is 16-bit additive.

endpoints.name: djitools::version
djitools::simple_checksum

data_types.description: A raw byte buffer of any length with no required encoding or structure. May contain any 8-bit values (0x00–0xFF), including embedded NULs and non-printable bytes. Suitable for functions that process generic byte sequences without format assumptions.
